name: Namibia

flag.description: A red diagonal band edged in white runs from the lower hoist to the upper fly, with a blue triangle bearing a golden twelve-rayed sun in the upper hoist and a green triangle in the lower fly.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky, the Atlantic and water, red the people and their heroism, green the vegetation and white peace and unity; the sun stands for life and energy.

hook: Namibia's red diagonal splits blue from green, and the golden sun in the blue corner is what sets it apart from Tanzania and DR Congo.
trivia: The flag was adopted at independence from South Africa in 1990.
The Namib is often called the oldest desert in the world, at tens of millions of years old.
Namibia was one of the first countries to write environmental protection into its constitution.
